text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Receiving praise from the other runners 
and the audience. ...This wasn't what I 
was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
A powerful presence—the objective was set. 
The next target, the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
was expected to feature the greatest 
lineup of this era.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
I'll take down every last one of them and 
make this my era.*/
